sources.note: Main company page. Describes MaxRemind as a healthcare billing/RCM services provider with 20+ years experience. Lists product suite including Maximus EHR, Max Charting, MaxCoder, MaxRPM, Provider Portal. HQ in Richardson, TX.

ONC certification and mandatory disclosures page. Lists certified criteria, product version 1.0, certification date Oct 2023. Describes clinical data capabilities, patient portal, care coordination, security, and EHI export features.

Maximus EHR product page. Describes AI-powered EHR with record management, document sharing, automated billing/claims, security, and AI-powered reporting. Mentions Plus/Ultra/Premium tiers but no detail on feature differences.

Dedicated Maximus EHR marketing site. Lists practice management features including scheduling, eligibility verification, lab integration, referral management, patient portal, e-prescribing, FHIR support, multi-location support. Claims 75+ specialties supported.
About page for Maximus EHR. Describes it as MaxRemind's flagship product. Mission statement about empowering practitioners. Based in Dallas, TX.
Products overview page. Lists 5 products: Maximus EHR, Max Charting App, MaxCoder, MaxRPM, Max Provider Portal. Describes them as an interconnected ecosystem.

MaxRPM product page. Remote patient monitoring collecting blood pressure, weight, pulse, glucose. Encrypted data transmission with alert system. Integration with Maximus EHR not specifically detailed.

Provider Portal product page. Billing-focused dashboard for managing billing records, claim status, payments, patient balances. Mobile apps on iOS and Android. Integrates with MaxRemind billing services.

Services page listing provider enrollment/credentialing, medical billing/coding, RCM, AI automation, and analytics. These are MaxRemind's core services business, distinct from but related to the EHR product.

Blog post about Maximus EHR. Describes AI-powered automation, voice recognition, smart templates, clinical decision support, predictive analytics, patient portal, and scalability from solo to multi-location practices.

Case study of Wound Healing Partners (Texas wound care clinic). Highlights follow-up workflow improvements, pre-built specialty templates, integrated scheduling, mobile access, and real-time charting.
SoftwareFinder listing for Maximus EHR. Lists features: scheduling, e-prescriptions, patient portal, mobile app, telemedicine, billing/invoicing, claims management. Custom pricing. Zero reviews.

TrustRadius page for MaxRemind Home Health Software (separate product). Zero reviews. Mentions patient billing, scheduling, electronic visit documentation, payment processing. Relationship to Maximus EHR unclear.
